global_guards: No effect is authorized for rendering.
Native beat markers and audible musical role must both confirm a trigger.
Retention/watch-time impact is a hypothesis only and not predicted.

proposals.concurrent_hits: ignore transient candidates while slow push is active
proposals.creative_hypothesis: If the vocal carries the passage, preserve stillness and use one imperceptible slow push.
proposals.density: one envelope in the 7 s window
proposals.measured_basis: Early lower-energy region; 00:14 one-second RMS proxy 0.1583 and 00:21 0.1543. Vocal/emotional interpretation is not yet verified by listening.
proposals.safe_crop: must pass existing base-framing safe-area contract at peak scale
proposals.vocal_override: cancel motion if consonant articulation or head/hand movement already supplies emphasis

proposals.concurrent_hits: merge events within 12 frames; never stack scale envelopes
proposals.creative_hypothesis: If native overlay and listening confirm a short regular groove, apply micro-pushes on at most two of the three events.
proposals.measured_basis: Three strong broadband/high-band transient candidates from exact mixed master; instrument class and beat role remain unknown.
proposals.safe_crop: peak scale must retain ceiling/floor/white-border exclusions
proposals.vocal_override: skip accents under exposed sustained notes or emotional phrase endings

proposals.concurrent_hits: choose the strongest verified event only
proposals.creative_hypothesis: If listening and native beats confirm one genuine structural impact, use a single restrained shake; otherwise use no shake.
proposals.density: maximum 1 shake in the 7.1 s window
proposals.measured_basis: Low-band-weighted transient candidates coincide with two of the strongest whole-song one-second RMS regions (186 s and 192 s); instrument/downbeat status unknown.
proposals.safe_crop: pre-scale to safe base crop; reject any forbidden border exposure
proposals.vocal_override: no shake on delicate onset, held note, breath or lyric landing
